content:
The highly anticipated television Emmys kick off this weekend with the first round of Creative Arts Awards winners being announced. The primetime ceremony will take place on September 14, where top honours such as Best Drama Series and Best Comedy Series will be handed out.

So far, Apple should be very pleased with its performance, with its Apple TV+ leading the pack with a record-breaking 20 awards this weekend. The majority of those come from the popular comedy Widows Bay, which took home 8 wins and is now the frontrunner for every award in the comedy categories.

In the current 2026 Emmy tally, Apple leads with 20, HBO Max trails with 16, and Netflix sits third with 13. Once the primetime Emmys are all handed out, the latter two streamers are expected to leapfrog Apple, though Apple will remain in a respectable third place.

Apple is expected to dominate the comedy categories but may fall short in drama to shows like The Pitt. The answers will come next Monday.

To date, Widows Bay has won 8, Pluribus has won 4, Margo's Got Money Troubles has won 3, Palm Royale has also won 3, and documentary Mr Scorsese has won 1.

Those Apple TV shows account for 19 wins; Apple picked up another win for its ad 'I'm Not Remarkable', bringing the total to the 20 referenced in the headline:

Widow's Bay

  • Best Guest Actress in a Comedy Series: Betty Gilpin
  • Best Production Design for a Half-Hour Program
  • Best Casting for a Comedy Series
  • Best Cinematography for a Half-Hour Series
  • Best Original Score for a Series
  • Best Music Supervision
  • Best Sound Editing for a Half-Hour Comedy or Drama Series or Animation
  • Best Sound Mixing for a Half-Hour Comedy or Drama Series or Animation

Pluribus

  • Best Production Design for a Contemporary Program of One Hour or More
  • Best Editing for a Drama Series
  • Best Original Main Title Theme Music
  • Best Sound Mixing for a One-Hour Comedy or Drama Series

Margo's Got Money Troubles

  • Best Contemporary Costumes for a Series
  • Best Contemporary Hairstyling
  • Best Contemporary Makeup (Non-Prosthetic)

Palm Royale

  • Best Choreography for a Scripted Program
  • Best Period Costumes for a Series
  • Best Period or Fantasy/Sci-Fi Makeup (Non-Prosthetic)

Mr. Scorsese

  • Best Documentary or Nonfiction Series

Apple TV entered this season with a record-breaking 89 Emmy nominations; how many of those it converts into trophies at the primetime Emmy ceremony on September 14 remains to be seen. It all once again underscores the high level of critical praise for Apple's overall programming slate.
